data.name: Nighat
data.gender_notes: Nighat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Nahat' meaning 'Night'. This beautiful name signifies the serenity and peacefulness of the night. The name Nighat carries the meaning “Night” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Nighat usually hope their child will grow to embody night and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child blessed with the grace and beauty of the night, radiating peace and tranquility in their presence.
data.etymology: Nighat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Night.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nighat total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: نِيحَط
in_arabic.meaning: أسم ناتج عن الجمع بين نيه و حط، يعني المثبتة على القلب
in_arabic.long_meaning: يعد اسم نيهات من أسماء البنات في الإسلام، وتستند أسماء نيهات إلى الجمع بين نيه و حط، وتعني المثبتة على القلب، أو المطمئة، أو ما يحتاج إلى الحفظ، ويستمد اسم نيهات من الجذور العربية، ويوصف بالجدير بالحفظ، ويظهر اسم نيهات في القرآن الكريم، ويغلب عليه المعنى الإيجابي، ويحمل اسم نيهات معاني متعددة كالوضوح، والسلوان، والرقة، ويحمل اسم نيهات أيضًا بعض المعاني السلبية مثل العصبية، والغضب، ويختلف اسم نيهات في المعنى بين الأفراد، ويعد اسم نيهات من أسماء البنات الشائعة في المجتمعات الإسلامية، ويغلب على اسم نيهات المعنى الإيجابي في الثقافة الإسلامية

in_english.name: Nighat
in_english.long_meaning: Nighat is a Persian name that means captivating, fascinating, attraction, love, affection. It is derived from the Arabic root ni-ḥ-t, which means to attract or captivate. In Islamic tradition, Nighat is considered a beautiful and meaningful name, symbolizing the power of love and attraction. It is a popular name in many Muslim cultures, including Persian, Arabic, and Urdu-speaking communities. Nighat is often associated with positive qualities such as kindness, compassion, and intelligence. In some cultures, Nighat is also associated with more negative traits such as obsession or possessiveness. Despite this, Nighat remains a beloved and enduring name in Islamic tradition.
